title: Laal Ishq
desc: Vaibhav from the Archaeology Department finds a magical pot and the pot's spirit lures him by promising to fulfil his wishes. But, for every wish he fulfils, he kills one of Vaibhav's family members.

desc: Lord Krishna, once a naughty little child, grows up and embarks on a number of adventures to fight and eradicate evil forces and provide justice to all.
